lines.en: Good morning! What can I get you?

lines.es: Buenos días. ¿A cuánto está el kilo de tomates?
lines.en: Good morning. How much is a kilo of tomatoes?

lines.es: A dos euros el kilo. Están muy maduros.
lines.en: Two euros a kilo. They're very ripe.
That's dirt cheap! A kilo, please.
Here you are. Anything else?

lines.es: Sí, un pepino y dos pimientos verdes.
lines.en: Yes, a cucumber and two green peppers.
Are they for a gazpacho?
Yes! For my cooking class.
Then you need garlic. A head?
Yes, thanks. How much is everything?
Four euros fifty.
Can I pay by card?

lines.es: Claro. ¡Que te salga muy rico el gazpacho!
lines.en: Of course. I hope your gazpacho turns out delicious!

lines.es: Hola, buenos días. ¿Quieres probar nuestro aceite de oliva?
lines.en: Hello, good morning. Would you like to taste our olive oil?
Yes, please!

lines.es: Toma un trozo de pan. Es aceite de Jaén.
lines.en: Take a piece of bread. It's oil from Jaén.
Mmm… How delicious!
Isn't it? It's very smooth.
How much does this bottle cost?

lines.es: La grande, doce euros. La pequeña, seis.
lines.en: The big one, twelve euros. The small one, six.

lines.es: Es un poco caro… La pequeña, por favor.
lines.en: It's a bit expensive… The small one, please.
Very good. Do you need anything else?

lines.es: Sí, también una botella de vinagre.
lines.en: Yes, also a bottle of vinegar.

lines.es: Aquí tienes. Son ocho euros en total.
lines.en: Here you are. That's eight euros in total.
Great. Thank you very much!
Thank you. And come back soon!
Hi! What can I get you two?

lines.es: Para mí, un café con leche, por favor.
lines.en: For me, a white coffee, please.
And for your friend?
An orange juice.
Anything to eat?
Yes. What tapas do you have?

lines.es: Tortilla de patatas, croquetas y pan con tomate.
lines.en: Potato omelette, croquettes and bread with tomato.

lines.es: Una tapa de tortilla para compartir.
lines.en: A tapa of omelette to share.
Very good. Anything else?
No, nothing else, thanks.
Here you are. Enjoy!
Can I pay, please?
That's five euros twenty.

lines.es: ¡Espera, Marina! Falta algo en la lista.
lines.en: Wait, Marina! Something's missing from the list.
What's missing?
The salt!

lines.es: ¡Ay, es verdad! Vamos a otro puesto.
lines.en: Oh, that's true! Let's go to another stall.
OK. Phew, the bags are really heavy!

lines.es: Sí, pero ya tenemos todo para la clase.
lines.en: Yes, but now we have everything for the class.

lines.es: Oye, ¿quieres cocinar juntas un día en tu casa?
lines.en: Hey, do you want to cook together one day at your place?
Of course! Next Saturday?
Great! I love the idea.
What shall we make?
A Spanish omelette?

lines.es: Vale. ¡Yo hago la tortilla y tú el postre!
lines.en: OK. I'll make the omelette and you make dessert!
Deal! See you on Saturday.

narr.c2: [cheerfully] Conversation two: at the olive oil shop!
narr.c3: [cheerfully] Conversation three: at the market bar!
